note: Stages and exit gates (skill roblox-production-pipeline). `python3 tools/production.py status` shows the current stage's gates; `python3 tools/plan_issues.py` writes issue drafts for them. Only the owner moves `current`, after recording the stage's owner and playtest gates in a release/owner-*.json file.

stages.goal: Decide what the game is, from the game-build request or the owner: identity, audience, platforms and the core loop on paper.

exit.text: Brief identity fields decided and logged in docs/decisions.md and the AGENTS.md tables
Core loop written up (docs/design/core-loop.md, Status no longer TBD)
Owner approves the brief and the core loop

stages.goal: Make the core loop playable with untextured geometry; wire the chosen kits into the boot phases; settle the engine settings.

exit.text: World layout, kits and engine settings decided (engine settings set in default.project.json or Studio)
Screen and flow map written (docs/design/ux-flows.md)
The game gate passes with the boot phases wired for the chosen kits
Boot report ok on both sides in Play Solo and Server & Clients (owner's Studio run)
Internal playtest of the core loop in greybox; findings filed as issues

stages.goal: One representative slice at target quality: art, audio, UI, feel and one complete progression step.

exit.text: Characters, progression and the UI, art and audio directions decided
Art direction written (docs/design/art-direction.md)
Audio direction written (docs/design/audio-direction.md)
Motion and flash settings honoured, asset provenance complete, localisation keys resolved
Playtest of the slice on each declared device class
Owner approves the slice as the quality bar

stages.goal: Feature complete: every system in, persistence, economy, commerce and telemetry wired. Every required brief field is decided from here on.

exit.text: Economy, monetization, social features and success metrics decided
Economy written up with sources, sinks and simulation results (docs/design/economy.md)
Remotes guarded, catalog and receipts right, paid random items disclosed, text filtered, telemetry defined, persistence through the data kit
Critical flows, mock purchases and the telemetry sequence checked in Studio (owner)
Full-loop playtest; every critical-flow failure filed

stages.goal: Content complete: polish, performance, localisation and device coverage; playtests with a Limited audience set by the owner.

exit.text: Performance within budget, localisation complete, no deprecated APIs, store text rules, release metadata valid
Locales and regions, device captures and the performance capture done in Studio (owner)
Limited-audience playtest (owner sets the audience); findings triaged

stages.goal: Everything the release checker automates passes; the owner completes the owner items and publishes. Agents never publish.

exit.text: The game gate passes at the pre-release tier (it runs the release checker)
Every automated release check passes
Owner items recorded (account, maturity questionnaire, store page, products, settings, publish, after-publish)
The owner publishes from Studio with version notes (never an agent)
